verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents its own in-person options: a Tap to Phone SDK for iOS and Android that lets merchants take contactless payments, plus a 'Process payments with a device' guide alongside online payments. The pack never states that these in-person payments settle into the same merchant balances, deposits and reporting as online payins, so that half of the story is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of shared settlement and balances for in-person and online payments, unified reporting across channels, terminal hardware details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder with offline sellers, in-person works on the same stack — terminals or tap-to-pay SDKs that settle into the same seller balances and reporting as online payments

citations.quote: Rainforest currently supports processing Tap to Phone payments utilizing the Rainforest SDK on iOS and Android devices.
Tap to Phone enables merchants to accept contactless payments directly on a compatible device.
